text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Summer's already over, huh? Well, I feel 
like I got some pretty solid training in, 
yeah!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you were able to spend such 
meaningful time. Well done, Guinea 
Pig-kun.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Still, don't let your guard down! There 
are only 2 months left until the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I intend to perfect your body and prepare 
every condition that favors your victory, 
so count on it!
